title: Lesson 8: Middleware Tradeoffs: MuleSoft vs Boomi vs Custom (and When Salesforce Is the Hub)
description: How to choose the integration layer: MuleSoft's API-led pro-code platform, Boomi's low-code iPaaS, hand-rolled custom code, and the decision matrix for when Salesforce itself should be the hub instead of any middleware at all.
